output.answer_markdown: Jacobs Solutions Inc.'s FY2023 operating income exceeded Comfort Systems USA Inc.'s by $656.8 million, as originally reported [1]. Jacobs' originally filed FY2023 operating income was $1.1 billion [2], and that figure was later restated, so the latest restated value is not given here. Comfort Systems USA's FY2023 operating income was $418.4 million [3].
